description: Add the modal SlideEditorWindow (WPF) and wire the library's Edit action to open it, persist on Save-and-close, and refresh the grid. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (uses SlideOperations). The window edits a deep copy of the presentation and only persists via SlidePresentationService.UpdateAsync on Save; Close/X discards. OperatorWindow stays StaticResource-free; the new window merges OwcDesignSystem.xaml. Add-to-service remains a Stage-3 stub.

Create c:\Users\Quang\Documents\OneWorshipcenter\owc-multitrack-feature-lyric-presenter\owc-multitrack-feature-lyric-presenter\.worktrees\slides-stage2\WorshipPlayer.Presenter\Views\Slides\SlideEditorWindow.xaml.cs: constructor SlideEditorWindow(SlidePresentation presentation, ISlidePresentationService service). Keep a working reference to the passed presentation (it is already a fresh GetByIdAsync object; treat it as the editable copy). Call SlideOperations.Normalize(presentation.Slides) on load, bind an ObservableCollection of slide rows (or the Slides list) to SlidesListBox, prefill NameTextBox with presentation.Name. Wire: + -> SlideOperations.AddSlide + select the new slide; Delete -> SlideOperations.DeleteSlide at SelectedIndex + reselect a valid neighbor; Move up/down -> SlideOperations.MoveUp/MoveDown + keep the moved slide selected; on selection change load SelectedSlide.Text into SlideTextBox and on text change write it back to the selected slide; toggle the placeholder on SlideTextBox text/selection changes.

In SlideEditorWindow.xaml.cs implement Save-and-close: push NameTextBox.Text into presentation.Name (if blank keep the prior non-empty name; the service also normalizes blank to 'New Presentation'), await service.UpdateAsync(presentation), set a public SlidePresentation? Result = presentation, DialogResult = true, Close(). Implement Close (and window X): DialogResult = false, Close() — persist nothing. Make the Save handler async void and guard against double-invoke.

Do NOT change OnAddPresentationToServiceRequested (keep the Stage-3 stub). Do NOT add StaticResource usage to OperatorWindow.xaml.
